name: Festtage (Festival Days) at Staatsoper Unter den Linden
description: The Festival Days at the Staatsoper Unter den Linden are among the cultural highlights of the Berlin spring. This special festival series presents international stars, major orchestral works, and impressive productions. The 2026 programme includes Richard Strauss's Der Rosenkavalier, Schubert songs, and Brahms's A German Requiem, offering top-class concerts and opera in Berlin's most historic opera house.
